Meet Star

Hi, I'm Star — the owner and baker behind Star's Sweet Treats. I've been making custom treats for many years, mostly cakes, and recently I switched gears to something new: cake pops and cakesicles!

A cake pop is fully cooked cake, mixed, rolled and cut into shapes, then dipped in a chocolate candy coating and decorated. Cake pops are the smaller ones, on a lollipop stick; cakesicles are a bit bigger, on a popsicle stick. I make every one myself, in small batches, in your colours and flavours.

My favourite way to eat one? Cold. Pop it in the fridge for 10 minutes first — the coating goes crisp and breakable, and oh so delicious. Questions or flavour ideas? I love hearing them, so send them along with your order.

Questions

How far ahead do I need to order?

At least 2 weeks ahead, please — and a minimum of 1 month for weddings and large orders. I bake everything to order, and dates fill up.

Is there a minimum order?

Yes — a minimum of 6 treats per order.

What's the difference between a cake pop and a cakesicle?

Both start the same way — fully cooked cake, mixed and shaped, then dipped in a chocolate candy coating and decorated. Cake pops are smaller and come on a lollipop stick; cakesicles are a bit larger and come on a popsicle stick.

How does ordering work?

Fill out the order form below. Your order stays approval pending until I confirm it by email - that's when your total and pick-up date are set. A 50% deposit by e-transfer or cash books your date, and the rest is due at pickup.

I need my order in under 2 weeks. Can you rush it?

Maybe! Tick the "Rush order" box on the order form and put the date you need in the Notes, or email me directly. I'll confirm whether I can fit it in — rush orders are paid in full upfront.

What flavours can I choose?

There are 16 flavours (see the list above), plus custom flavours — just ask. You can pick up to 2 flavours per dozen.

How long do my treats keep?

My rule of thumb is 1-2-3: 1 week on the counter, 2 weeks in the fridge, 3 weeks in the freezer. My favourite way to eat a cake pop is chilled — 10 minutes in the fridge makes the coating crisp.

What about allergies?

My home kitchen handles wheat, milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, and soy, so treats aren't made in an allergen-free kitchen. Every treat is labelled with its ingredients — ask if you need details before ordering.

How do I pay?

E-transfer or cash. A 50% deposit once I confirm your order, with the balance due at pickup.

Where do I pick up?

Pickup is in Belleville, arranged with me when your order is confirmed.

Can I buy treats without ordering ahead?

Yes — a selection is stocked at Brynn's Fresh Market, Nana's Olde Fashioned Fudge & Gifts, and K'boodle (see Available At, above). Stock varies by store.

Something wrong on this page?

Spot a mistake or have an idea? Tell me here — every message goes to Cameron, who looks after this website and the order form.
